Prepared example: these buyer answers and citation gaps are illustrative. The real scoring and allocation code produced the saved report and plan, with no provider calls.

tactics.name: Publish "X vs Y" comparison pages (per 3)
tactics.description: Owned comparison pages that answer buyer-intent queries directly.

tactics.name: FAQ + Product schema + llms.txt on your pages
tactics.description: Foundational: makes your pages easier for AI to parse and cite — multiplies everything else.

tactics.name: G2 / Capterra / ProductHunt profile + seed reviews
tactics.description: Claim review-platform profiles and seed genuine reviews (high impact for B2B).

tactics.name: 10–15 genuine Reddit / community answers
tactics.description: Helpful, non-spammy answers in communities AI assistants cite.

tactics.name: Get into a "best X" roundup (outreach ± paid)
tactics.description: Land in listicles/roundups — the format AI assistants quote most for recommendations.

tactics.name: Digital PR / HARO responses
tactics.description: Earned news/editorial mentions via journalist requests.

projection.disclaimer: This is a MODELED projection based on the assumptions above, not a guarantee. Actual results vary with execution quality, competition, and how AI assistants weight sources.
assumptions: Prepared example: citation gaps and buyer answers are illustrative, not observed market evidence.
Citation share → traffic uses a category volume of 10,000 monthly searches (assumed — connect GSC to ground this).
20% of category queries assumed to happen via AI assistants.
30% assumed click-through when cited in an AI answer.
Each tactic contributes a fixed citation-lift; effect is capped at +25pp and 60% share.
Gaps not yet grounded in crawled evidence — run Diagnose to raise confidence.
